children: Stitch Fix's revenue outlook for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 reflects a timing decision that pulled volume forward. The company said it adjusted the timing of some Fix shipments into the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, which shifted volume away from the first quarter. An unintended change to the post-checkout offer flow in Aug. also limited the number of clients eligible to request another Fix, though the company said this has been corrected. 1Q revenue guidance of $323 million to $328 million represents a 4.1% to 5.6% decline year-over-year.
